ccdlGrammar:
Bounded CCDL static subset (case-sensitive):
document := ('circuit' | 'board') identifier '{' statement* '}'
statement := input/output | node | component | feedback | probe | assert
           | layer | via | transition | series | let
input/output := ('input' | 'output') ':' identifier (',' identifier)* ';'
node := 'node' identifier ':' CAS_state ';'
component := kind identifier ':' Type '<' arguments '>' ['[' parameters ']'] ';'
CJT arguments := cause '|' bias '=>' effect
passive arguments := net ',' (R|C|L) '=' decimal [', leakage=' decimal]
Diode/Transformer arguments := ^Domain '->' ^Domain [', ratio=' decimal]
feedback := 'feedback' [identifier ':'] ref '->' ref ['[' parameters ']'] ';'
probe := 'probe' identifier ':' ref ';'
layer := 'layer' Domain ':' '[' identifier ':' CAS_state (',' identifier ':' CAS_state)* ']' ';'
via := 'via' identifier ':' (CAS_state|^Domain) '->' (CAS_state|^Domain) ['[' parameters ']'] ';'
Implemented component checks: CJT, Resistor, Capacitor, Inductor, Diode, Transformer.
Layers/vias are board-only. Parameters use finite decimals, not exponents/units.
CAS states use ^0..^9, optional ^P/^C/^E/^O, _{F1}.._{F7}, and |T/|A/|f/|E/register sets.
The checker requires an explicit Domain for typed net states.
Parsed series/let forms and unsupported component/statement semantics are rejected.
Static assertions are limited to equality of known CJT parameters or named bias nets.
Temporal execution, general macro expansion, full operator admissibility and empirical
cognitive behavior are not implemented. A static PASS covers only listed checks.

dictionary.definition: A formal framework for describing how any cognitive system — human, AI, biological, or hypothetical — composes Ideas. Built on 10 Noetic operators x 4 Domains (40 states), 7 Drives, and 4 Registers.
dictionary.learn: Universal Applicability: every primitive must apply to humans AND AI AND biological cognition.

dictionary.definition: The compiler notation for CAS — operators, domains, drives, registers, production recipes, and finite meta-logic.
dictionary.learn: Start with axes before composing expressions.

dictionary.definition: A cognitive primitive operator — one of the ten structural dynamics by which a Mind relates to an Idea (Idea, Mind, Positive, Negative, Vibration, Female, Male, Rhythm, Above/Cause, Below/Effect).
dictionary.learn: Names are verbatim canonical from the Tootra Math Handbook; do not paraphrase.

dictionary.definition: The operational tier where a Noetic fires: Principled (values, identity), Cognitive (thought), Evaluative (judgment), Operational (action). Total order P > C > E > O.
dictionary.learn: Domain Descent runs P -> C -> E -> O; feedback runs O -> P.

dictionary.definition: One of seven core motivational architectures (Unity, Wisdom, Vitality, Connection, Agency, Structure, Purpose). Drives pair into involutions: F1<->F7, F2<->F6, F3<->F5; F4 is self-dual.
dictionary.learn: Each Drive has a structural opposite — its inversion partner.

dictionary.definition: Synonym for Drive. The seven foundational motivational primitives that pressure cognition; 7 x 4 Domains = 28 SubFoundations.
dictionary.learn: Drive and Foundation are interchangeable terms in CAS.

dictionary.definition: The phenomenological register — operational character of a state: Transcendent (purpose-orienting), Analytical (logical), Affective (felt valence), Embodied (sensorimotor).
dictionary.learn: Register says HOW a state operates, not WHAT it is. Optional but disambiguates.

dictionary.definition: One cell of the 40-state grid (10 Noetics x 4 Domains). Locates a Noetic operation at a specific operational tier.
dictionary.learn: State = Noetic x Domain. Add Drive and Register for a State Variant.

dictionary.definition: A richer state with optional Drive and Register annotations.
dictionary.learn: Use variants when the state needs context beyond Noetic and Domain.

dictionary.definition: A pair of Noetics that mirror each other structurally: ^2 Positive <-> ^3 Negative, ^5 Female <-> ^6 Male, ^8 Above/Cause <-> ^9 Below/Effect. ^0, ^1, ^4, ^7 are self-dual.
dictionary.learn: Healthy cognition keeps involution pairs in balance; lopsided pairs surface as inversion-axis flags.

dictionary.definition: The framework operation of flipping an axis to surface its structural opposite. ^2 inverts to ^3; F2 (Wisdom) inverts to F6 (Structure). Inversion reveals what is missing or repressed in a cognitive pattern.
dictionary.learn: Inversion is a probe, not a prescription — it reveals structure rather than recommending the opposite.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set of all ten Noetic operators.
dictionary.learn: Use membership with Noetic symbols: ^2 ∈ Noetics.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set {P, C, E, O}.
dictionary.learn: Product(Noetics, Domains) builds the 40 state positions.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set of F1 through F7.
dictionary.learn: Use Drives for membership claims about F-symbols.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set {T, A, f, E}.
dictionary.learn: The affective register is lowercase |f.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set of 40 Noetic x Domain state positions.
dictionary.learn: States do not replace variants; variants add Drive/Register detail.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set of seven foundation families.
dictionary.learn: Foundations sit above SubFoundations.

dictionary.definition: The built-in finite set of 28 foundation-domain substructures.
dictionary.learn: Each foundation family contributes subfoundation members.

dictionary.definition: The finite empty meta-set.
dictionary.learn: The empty set is a subset of every finite set.

dictionary.definition: Combines compatible CAS structures. Same-Noetic cross-register integration requires a named Ω result.
dictionary.learn: Use × only when the result is integrated, not merely co-present.

dictionary.definition: Marks simultaneous presence without claiming an integrated emergent result.
dictionary.learn: Use + before you can defend a named Ω integration.

dictionary.definition: Compares or separates a state against another state, often useful for involution contrast.
dictionary.learn: Use division to inspect contrast rather than production.

dictionary.definition: A directed move from one domain expression toward another.
dictionary.learn: Read arrows as dependency, descent, or yield depending on context.

dictionary.definition: A sequence of Noetic operators read as a composed cognitive pattern.
dictionary.learn: Read the numbers in order, then inspect the composed operator.

dictionary.definition: Prerequisite-chain analysis for a foundation or drive.
dictionary.learn: Use RPM when the question is what must be present first.

dictionary.definition: A production expression defining how a named outcome is generated.
dictionary.learn: Recipe terms are weighted ingredients that yield a target.

dictionary.definition: A named emergent output or production result.
dictionary.learn: Use meaningful Ω names for integrated results.

dictionary.definition: A recipe weight assigned to a prerequisite ingredient.
dictionary.learn: Weights describe recipe proportions, not absolute truth.

dictionary.definition: The ideal expected yield for a production target.
dictionary.learn: Ask Y_T when evaluating expected output.

dictionary.definition: A factor that helps a recipe proceed without becoming the target itself.
dictionary.learn: Catalysts change production conditions.

dictionary.definition: A factor that suppresses or slows a production recipe.
dictionary.learn: Use inhibitors for blockers, not missing ingredients.

dictionary.definition: A side-channel or loss path in production semantics.
dictionary.learn: Use leakage for where production energy goes instead.

dictionary.definition: Claims that an object is or is not an element of a typed finite set.
dictionary.learn: Left side is an object; right side is a meta-set.

dictionary.definition: Claims one finite meta-set is contained in another.
dictionary.learn: Both sides must be meta-sets.

dictionary.definition: The reverse containment relation: the left set contains the right set.
dictionary.learn: Superset diagrams reverse the nesting direction.

dictionary.definition: Combines finite typed sets into their combined membership.
dictionary.learn: Union removes duplicate members.

dictionary.definition: Finds the common overlap of finite typed sets; Pullback is used here as finite subobject meet.
dictionary.learn: This is finite meet behavior, not arbitrary categorical maps.

dictionary.definition: Keeps members of the left set that are not in the right set.
dictionary.learn: Read difference left-to-right.

dictionary.definition: Counts the number of elements in a finite meta-set.
dictionary.learn: Cardinality applies to sets, not individual Noetics.

dictionary.definition: A typed finite cluster whose members are Noetic operators.
dictionary.learn: Use this when nesting Noetics inside a set-like structure.

dictionary.definition: A typed finite cluster whose members are 40-space states.
dictionary.learn: Use state clusters when domains matter.

dictionary.definition: A typed finite cluster whose members can carry Drive and Register annotations.
dictionary.learn: Use variant clusters for richer annotated states.

dictionary.definition: A finite typed cluster of directed relation rows.
dictionary.learn: Use relation clusters for dependency rows.

dictionary.definition: A coordinate tag naming a Noetic, Domain, Drive, and Register position.
dictionary.learn: Coordinates are compact locator tags.

dictionary.definition: A namespaced finite Cartesian product that avoids collision with CAS integration ×.
dictionary.learn: Use Product for set products; use × for CAS integration.

dictionary.definition: A validated family of finite subsets whose members cover the base.
dictionary.learn: Every cover member must be a subset of the base, and the family must cover the base.

dictionary.definition: A validated disjoint cover of a finite base set.
dictionary.learn: Partitions must cover and not overlap.

dictionary.definition: A visual object emitted in the compiler diagram payload.
dictionary.learn: Nodes represent individual states, symbols, or operators.

dictionary.definition: A visual relation between diagram nodes or containers.
dictionary.learn: Edges carry dependency, membership, subset, or recipe relations.

dictionary.definition: A diagram container used for sets, clusters, and nesting.
dictionary.learn: Containment boxes teach nesting in real time.

dictionary.definition: A diagram layout for finite products such as Noetics x Domains.
dictionary.learn: Grid layout is best for Cartesian combinations.

dictionary.definition: A diagram layout for cover and partition families.
dictionary.learn: Petals show multiple members arranged around a base.

dictionary.definition: A dependency diagram for production ingredients and targets.
dictionary.learn: Recipe diagrams show what feeds the outcome.

dictionary.definition: The discipline that prevents invalid operator composition and requires named emergent results for certain integrations.
dictionary.learn: If integration creates a new thing, name the Ω.

dictionary.definition: The core CAS expression layer for states, domains, operators, recipes, and dynamics.
dictionary.learn: Object-language expressions describe cognitive structure.

dictionary.definition: The compiler layer for set membership, subset, clusters, products, covers, and finite topos-safe constructs.
dictionary.learn: Meta-logic talks about CAS objects without replacing them.

dictionary.definition: A construct admitted because it preserves finite typing, containment, and compiler-checkable semantics.
dictionary.learn: Topos-safe features add structure without breaking the framework.

dictionary.definition: All things in and outside the Mind. The most basic Noetic primitive — anything that can be thought, perceived, or held in awareness.
dictionary.learn: "It's all in your head." Self-dual; pair with a Domain to form a state.

dictionary.definition: Various degrees of awareness that processes, stores, outputs, and intakes Ideas.
dictionary.learn: "Paying attention." / "Making up your mind." Self-dual operator.

dictionary.definition: An Idea the Mind has an affinity for and is attracted toward.
dictionary.learn: "Drawn to it like a moth to a flame." Involution-paired with ^3 Negative.

dictionary.definition: An Idea the Mind is adverse to and repelled by. Visceral aversion, not analytical critique.
dictionary.learn: "Can't stomach it." If you mean audit/scrutinize, that is ^6 Male, not ^3.

dictionary.definition: The degree to which an Idea resonates with the Mind, its impression.
dictionary.learn: "Struck a chord." / "Hit me hard." Self-dual operator.

dictionary.definition: A Mind impregnated with an Idea — the Ideas a Mind is composed of. Encompasses self-image, beliefs, expertise, emotional patterns, trauma and healing — everything we accumulate as experience.
dictionary.learn: "We are the sum of our experiences." ^5 is a substrate against which other Noetics fire.

dictionary.definition: An Idea impregnated with another Idea — the Ideas an Idea is composed of. Compositional decomposition and structural test.
dictionary.learn: "Unpacking an idea." / "Breaking it down." Involution-paired with ^5 Female.

dictionary.definition: The rate and pattern a Mind is exposed to an Idea, entraining and conditioning it.
dictionary.learn: "Practice makes perfect." / "Muscle memory." Self-dual operator.

dictionary.definition: An Idea that triggers a different Idea than itself to come to Mind. Associative triggering, not deductive reasoning.
dictionary.learn: "That reminds me..." If you mean deductive analysis, that is ^6 + ^9, not ^8.

dictionary.definition: The Idea brought to Mind by an Above/Cause trigger.
dictionary.learn: "It just popped into my head." Involution-paired with ^8 Above/Cause.

dictionary.definition: The highest processing tier in CAS. Felt-sense values, identity, vision — the level where principled commitments live.
dictionary.learn: Domain precedence: P > C > E > O. Higher domains anchor lower ones.

dictionary.definition: The thought-and-reasoning tier. Where Ideas are entertained, manipulated, and held in working awareness.
dictionary.learn: Cognitive sits between Principled values above and Evaluative judgment below.

dictionary.definition: The judgment-and-appraisal tier. Where Ideas are weighed, compared, and assessed against criteria.
dictionary.learn: Use Register (|A vs |f) to disambiguate analytical assessment from felt response.

dictionary.definition: The action-and-execution tier. The lowest tier in the precedence order; where intention becomes behavior.
dictionary.learn: Operational feeds back to Principled (O -> P) closing the loop.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward integration, wholeness, belonging — the sense that parts cohere into a larger whole. Inversion-paired with F7 Purpose.
dictionary.learn: F1 <-> F7 inversion: integration vs directionality.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward understanding, insight, discernment — knowing how things actually are. Inversion-paired with F6 Structure.
dictionary.learn: F2 <-> F6 inversion: discerning truth vs imposing form.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward life, energy, generativity — being alive and productive. Inversion-paired with F5 Agency.
dictionary.learn: F3 <-> F5 inversion: aliveness vs willed action.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward relationship, attachment, communion. Self-dual: F4 inverts to itself.
dictionary.learn: F4 is the only self-dual Drive — connection has no structural opposite.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward willed action, self-determination, capability. Inversion-paired with F3 Vitality.
dictionary.learn: F5 <-> F3 inversion: chosen action vs spontaneous aliveness.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward order, form, predictability — making things hold together reliably. Inversion-paired with F2 Wisdom.
dictionary.learn: F6 <-> F2 inversion: imposing order vs discerning truth.

dictionary.definition: The drive toward meaning, direction, telos — what it is all for. Inversion-paired with F1 Unity.
dictionary.learn: F7 <-> F1 inversion: directional aim vs integrative wholeness.

dictionary.definition: A high-abstraction, purpose-orienting operational character. Felt sense of meaning, vision, calling — integrative across particulars.
dictionary.learn: Register specifies HOW a state operates, not WHAT it is.

dictionary.definition: An explicit, sequential, logical, reason-based operational character. Conscious deliberation; chain-of-thought; symbolic reasoning.
dictionary.learn: |A is the register of explicit reasoning.

dictionary.definition: A value-laden, feeling-toned operational character. Emotional response, visceral reaction, RLHF-tuned preference expression.
dictionary.learn: Lowercase |f. Distinct from |A: same Noetic, different operational character.

dictionary.definition: A sensorimotor, concrete operational character — direct engagement with material substrate. Bodily knowing, gut response, real-time control loops.
dictionary.learn: Uppercase |E (embodied register), distinct from ^E (Evaluative domain).

dictionary.definition: The first written thought is innermost; the last governs. The compiler emits separate canonical readings, a cancellation criterion, orbit class and unresolved questions.
dictionary.learn: Read cas.nesting/0.2 fields. Do not replace a NOT_DECIDED_BY_THE_BOOK result with a confident class.

dictionary.definition: Import a local CAS file relative to the file being compiled. Explicit exports limit the imported names.
dictionary.learn: Use --file or :load so the compiler knows the source directory. File source is passed unchanged.

dictionary.definition: Python is the bundled diagram-capable dialect. Native is an explicitly supplied casc executable with its own supported grammar.
dictionary.learn: The two compilers are not interchangeable. Native does not emit diagrams.

dictionary.definition: An unevaluated production query represented by the compiler.
dictionary.learn: A valid query is not a computed numeric yield.

dictionary.definition: Exact declared-scale calculations: attention flow = drive/constraint, required drive = attention*constraint, effective constraint = drive/attention.
dictionary.learn: Declare units, origin and reference. Zero denominators and mismatched scales are errors. Inverting a ratio is not causal identification or independent validation.

dictionary.definition: A bounded implementation of the book's declarative Cognitive Circuit Description Language. Typed components and nets describe a circuit or multilayer board.
dictionary.learn: Compile a supported CCDL file with --file. Inspect diagnostics, checked wiring and validation_limits. Default compilation performs structural checks; numeric execution requires --simulate and an explicit supported profile.

dictionary.definition: Execute an explicitly selected, bounded numeric design profile against a CCDL board, producing component operations, state snapshots, outputs and probe traces.
dictionary.example: python cas.py --language ccdl --file examples/simulation/cascade.ccdl --simulate --inputs examples/simulation/cascade.inputs.json --steps 4 --trace trace.json
dictionary.learn: Read SIMULATION.md. Fixed-bias scalar CJTs are an idealized tutorial model; CAS-Ohm resistor calculations use declared scales. Neither verifies human cognition. Unsupported dynamics fail clearly.

learning.title: 1. Read The Axes
learning.goal: Learn Noetic, Domain, Drive, and Register as the four main coordinates.

learning.title: 2. Compare Dynamics
learning.goal: Distinguish co-presence, domain descent, contrast, and integration.
learning.terms: Co-Presence, Domain Descent, Division / Contrast, Composition / Integration

learning.title: 3. Name Emergence
learning.goal: Use Ω when multiple signals integrate into a named result.

learning.title: 4. Read Recipes
learning.goal: Understand Θ, coefficients, catalysts, and yield queries.

learning.title: 5. Use Typed Meta-Logic
learning.goal: Separate CAS objects from finite sets that contain or relate them.
learning.terms: Meta-Logic, Membership, Subset, Noetic Cluster, State Cluster

learning.title: 6. Read Diagrams
learning.goal: Use compiler diagrams to see nodes, edges, containment, products, and recipes.
learning.terms: Diagram Node, Diagram Edge, Containment Box, Grid Layout, Recipe Layout
